contingency: RISK-11 verdict NOT_MET-with-bound (UNDERPOWERED; all scored blocks mde_brier_80pct > PLAUSIBLE_EFFECT_BRIER=0.001; n_discrepancies=0; smallest defensible effect 0.002817725360790807). RISK-12 = funding-shock transmission family on the frozen Track A panel, per contingency ladder; distinct mechanism (funding innovations, not level/interaction).
family_slimming: none; all 6 members tested, family not slimmed
family_members: member_1 funding_lag (level) — positive control / replication anchor; prior campaigns found this not detectable at 0.001; exists so the new innovations are interpretable against the closed level result
member_2 funding_change_1h = funding_rate_{t-1} - funding_rate_{t-2}; declared direction > 0
member_3 funding_change_8h = funding_rate_{t-1} - funding_rate_{t-9}; declared direction > 0
member_4 funding_change_24h = funding_rate_{t-1} - funding_rate_{t-25}; declared direction > 0
member_5 abs_funding_change_8h = |funding_change_8h| (sign-agnostic shock magnitude); declared direction > 0
member_6 funding_change_8h_x_rv = funding_change_8h * rv_lag (amplification in high-RV hours); declared direction > 0

block_3.note: primary block for the headline claim

common_sample_rule: drop a coin-hour for all models whenever any of rv_lag, funding_lag, oi_change_lag, funding_change_24h is null (the 24h change requires t-25, so it is the strictest requirement and implies all shorter changes exist). All six members, the positive-control member, and RV-only are scored on the identical test rows. This prevents a fake paired-difference win.
outcome: y = 1 if liq_count >= 1 else 0 per (coin, hour); a zero means no event observed in the feed, not a confirmed no-liquidation hour

features.ret_t: ln(close_t / close_{t-1}) within coin, ordered by hour_utc
features.rv_lag: statistics.stdev of trailing 24 hourly log returns ending at t-1 (ret_{t-24..t-1})
features.oi_change_lag: ln(open_interest_usd_{t-1} / open_interest_usd_{t-2}); null if t-2 missing
features.funding_change_1h: funding_rate_{t-1} - funding_rate_{t-2}; null if any required lagged funding observation is missing
features.funding_change_8h: funding_rate_{t-1} - funding_rate_{t-9}; null if any required lagged funding observation is missing
features.funding_change_24h: funding_rate_{t-1} - funding_rate_{t-25}; null if any required lagged funding observation is missing

headline_contrast: each family member vs RV-only baseline on Brier score, block_3 primary
metrics: calibration OLS slope/intercept on test probabilities
placebo: label-hour permutation within hour across coins, 1000 permutations, fixed seed 20261119; empirical p and 95th percentile of null Brier difference per member
multiplicity: Holm over family = {member_1..member_6} x {block_2, block_3, pooled} at alpha=0.05; Holm family declared in prereg before outcomes
verdict_rule_per_member: SUPPORT iff block_3 Brier improvement > 0, p_raw < 0.05, p_holm < 0.05, and placebo 95th percentile < observed improvement; otherwise NOT_MET
overall_verdict: SUPPORT if any member passes; NOT_MET if all powered members fail; UNDERPOWERED if the power gate fails for all
power_gate: recompute MDE from the RISK-12 common sample block sizes and panel base rate only (outcome-blind); PLAUSIBLE_EFFECT_BRIER = 0.001 frozen; if all scored blocks' mde_brier_80pct > 0.001 then status=UNDERPOWERED, models_run=false, honest underpowered artifacts still written (all 11 files, non-empty)
mde_by_instrument_count: vary number of coins included in panel (1..13, fixed alphabetical coin order BTC,ETH,BNB,SOL,XRP,AVAX,DOGE,LINK,SUI,ARB,OP,APT,ADA); recompute base_rate, n_test, mde_brier_80pct per block per coin count; outcome-blind (uses block sizes and base rate only, not model-comparison outcomes)
smallest_defensible_effect: recomputed from the RISK-12 power output; min mde_brier_80pct across scored blocks at full instrument count (block_3 primary); the prior RISK-11 value 0.002817725360790807 is a reference only, not a hardcoded value, because the extended t-25 common sample changes n_test and base rate
effect_bound_decision_rule: NOT_MET-with-bound: no incremental value detectable above RV-only at PLAUSIBLE_EFFECT_BRIER=0.001 across all instrument counts; effect defensible only if >= smallest defensible effect
implementation: stdlib only (csv/math/statistics/random/hashlib/datetime/json); logistic regression fit by stdlib IRLS mirroring fit_logistic in session_20261119T130817Z/fclr_risk11_evaluation_20261119T130817Z.py; no scipy/numpy/statsmodels/pandas/pyarrow in core path; no ingest/alignment re-run; no zero-byte artifacts; no outcome mining; no family slimming
data_source: frozen panel research_state/session_20261119T022824Z/fclr_tracka_extension01_panel_session_20261119T022824Z.csv (113,880 coin-hours, 13 coins, 12 months 2025-11..2026-10; extension verdict ADMISSIBLE, frozen); only input
prohibitions: no sealed Binance months (2024-10 .. 2026-11) for outcomes
